text:
sophia (eng-ml): Quick sync — can we score + prioritize onboarding Mistral-22B-v2 for next-week bring-up? Need quantization (4-bit), full eval regression sweep (SQuAD, long-sum, safety), and perf targets (p99 < 220ms on Dedicated). Intake: https://redwood.company/incoming-models/12345. TL;DR: I'm proposing medium-high priority but want group scoring.

kevin (pm): Business question — is this for Composer product? If yes, impact = medium-high. Canary in prod within 3wks doable? :clock3:

maya (evals): Heads up — our harness currently degrades for some Mistral variants >4k tokens (hallucinations spike). I'll run long-context regression set and add semantic-qa + safety checks.

ana (research): (note: corrected name to ana) Ana here — our 4-bit quant experiments on Mistral clones looked promising: ~2.5x memory savings, ~+15% generation latency. Kernel scheduling in runtime could reclaim latency. I'll own quant bench.

liam (infra): GPU capacity is tight next 2 weeks. We can reserve a 1-day slot for a canary if we allocate 2x A100 (or 4x A10s) during off-peak. Need formal reservation request by EOD Wed.

deploy-bot: Deploy plan template created: /deploys/mistral-22b-v2-canary (fill in canary routes, fallback model).

maya (evals): Proposal for quick scoring (1-10): Quality risk = 5, Infra effort = 6, Business impact = 7, Observability = 4.

sophia (eng-ml): Let's apply rubric: weights quality 0.5, infra 0.2, biz 0.2, obs 0.1. Using Maya's numbers => score = 0.5*5 + 0.2*6 + 0.2*7 + 0.1*4 = 5.6. So "medium-high". Recommend P0 for quant bench + evals. :white_check_mark:

kevin (pm): Agreed. Swap with the smaller experimental model on the roadmap, push that out. @ana @maya please kick off tests by EOD Monday. :thumbsup:

ana (research): Starting quant bench now. Will post a short artifact table. Running command: ```python bench_quant.py --model mistral-22b-v2 --bits 4 --batch 1 --seq 2048 --profile kernels``` Will measure: tokens/sec, peak GPU mem, KV cache latency.

maya (evals): Added long-context + semantic-qa + safety eval sets to intake and opened PR: https://git/repo/pr/987 — test harness fails on one tox case, investigating. :eyes:

liam (infra): Submitted reservation request for 2x A100 for Mon 03:00-11:00 UTC. If anyone needs a different window tell me now.

sophia (eng-ml): Action items summary: 1) ana — quant bench + kernel perf (owner: ana, due: Mon EOD), 2) maya — long-context + safety evals + PR fixes (owner: maya, due: Mon EOD), 3) liam — reserve infra slot & prep canary cluster (owner: liam, due: Wed), 4) kevin — update roadmap / business comms (owner: kevin, due: Thu). I'll tentatively schedule canary Mar 30 pending results.

kevin (pm): Noted. We'll treat rollouts as "canary -> staged -> fallback to opt-quantless". Make sure runbooks include rollback criteria (BLEU drop >3 points or safety fail).

maya (evals): I'll add regression alerts to console: set baseline thresholds and automatic rollback trigger when quality delta > threshold.

deploy-bot: Canary checklist updated with rollback hooks, metrics dashboards, and tracing links.

sophia (eng-ml): Thanks all. Closing this thread for decisions — updates should be posted here.

liam (infra): acked.

ana (research): posting initial bench table shortly.

maya (evals): will link eval results in thread when ready.

sophia (eng-ml): :rocket:
